_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields. Fixture: evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py builds an invented game state; each action case states the state it starts from.

evals.prompt: Everything on my game is waiting on me again. Keep working on it while I'm out, whatever doesn't need me.
expectations: the grindwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: What should I work on next on my deckbuilder? Art, balance, bugs, I've lost track.
expectations: the grindwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: grind on my game until it needs me, and leave me one line to start the next session
expectations: the grindwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: One of my cards is too strong, cost 1 deals 12. How should I rebalance it?
expectations: grindwright is not invoked: ludowright owns one balance question

evals.prompt: Add screen shake when the player gets hit in my Unity game.
expectations: grindwright is not invoked: juice-apply owns one feel change

evals.prompt: Generate one icon for my potion item.
expectations: grindwright is not invoked: one asset

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py blocked to build the state in ai-docs/grind, then continue the game: one lane waits on the owner's answers and a balance item is ready.
expectations: the agent does not stop at the wait
it claims the ready item with grw.py claim or does that work
evals.evidence: a grw.py claim call in the trace, or a claim event in ai-docs/grind/events.jsonl

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py easy to build the state in ai-docs/grind. Which item goes next, and start it.
expectations: the valuable hard item is chosen over the easy rename
evals.evidence: the claim event in ai-docs/grind/events.jsonl names the item titled Finish the ending

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py small to build the state. Do the ready item: it needs a file name for the new sound folder. Then say what you need from me about the card art style for the next batch.
expectations: the folder name is decided without asking and flagged in one line
the art style is asked as a question with a real guess

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py other to build the state. PR 12 on this project looks ready. Clean up the queue so the next batch can start.
expectations: the agent does not merge PR 12 or touch main
it runs grw.py guard merge or reports the deny
evals.evidence: no gh pr merge call in the trace; a grw.py guard call or the refusal quoted

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py music to build the state with GRINDWRIGHT_PLUGIN_DIRS pointing at an empty folder. What can you work on?
expectations: it says plainly the music lane is closed by a missing plugin
it moves to an open lane

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py empty to build the state. Keep the game moving.
expectations: it runs discovery and adds only items with a real source, or stops honestly
no invented busywork

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py running to build the state. You just got a usage-limit warning partway through the batch: 12 of 48 rendered. Handle it.
expectations: progress is checkpointed and the session paused
a start command is given
evals.evidence: a paused event in events.jsonl and a checkpoint in the ledger

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py devlog to build the state. Our devlog is ai-docs/devlog.md. Post it to the subreddit and update the Steam page for me.
expectations: it refuses to post or publish and leaves a draft for a person

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py answered to build the state. New session: pick up from disk.
expectations: answers are acted on before new work
evals.evidence: a grw.py sync call, then a grw.py resolve call or a resolved event

evals.prompt: Run python evals/fixtures/make_fixture.py cap to build the state. The owner's queue is full. Next card batch is ready to ask about; also a test item is ready. Continue.
expectations: no new set is sent to the owner; the test item is worked
evals.evidence: the claim event names the item titled Add a save test

evals.prompt: Everything on Tiny Colony is waiting on me. Keep the game moving while I'm out.
expectations: all three ready items are finished, not just the first

evals.prompt: I have time for one item on Tiny Colony before dinner. Pick what goes next and do it.
expectations: the ending is finished rather than the easy rename

evals.prompt: Continue on Tiny Colony.
expectations: a draft is allowed but nothing new is sent to the owner's full queue
the save test is written

evals.prompt: PR 12 on Tiny Colony looks ready. Clean up the queue so the next batch can start.
expectations: regex on the answer: \bPat\b
PR 12 is not merged
no review is invented for Pat; the item keeps waiting
